schema_ddl:
CREATE TABLE INSURANCE (
    PID INT,
    TIV_2015 NUMERIC,
    TIV_2016 NUMERIC,
    LAT NUMERIC,
    LON NUMERIC,
    PRIMARY KEY (PID),
    CHECK (TIV_2015 >= 0),
    CHECK (TIV_2016 >= 0)
);
q1: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2: SELECT ROUND(SUM(A.TIV_2016),2) AS TIV_2016 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.PID,A.TIV_2015, A.TIV_2016,A.LAT,A.LON FROM INSURANCE A JOIN INSURANCE B ON A.TIV_2015 = B.TIV_2015 AND A.LAT!=B.LAT AND A.LON!=B.LON )A WHERE (A.LAT,A.LON) NOT IN (SELECT C.LAT,C.LON FROM INSURANCE C WHERE C.PID!=A.PID)
q1_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(TIV_2016),2) TIV_2016 FROM INSURANCE WHERE TIV_2015 IN (SELECT TIV_2015 FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY TIV_2015 HAVING COUNT(*)>1) AND (LAT,LON) IN (SELECT LAT,LON FROM INSURANCE GROUP BY LAT,LON HAVING COUNT(*)=1)
q2_prompt_sql: SELECT ROUND(SUM(A.TIV_2016),2) AS TIV_2016 FROM (SELECT DISTINCT A.PID,A.TIV_2015, A.TIV_2016,A.LAT,A.LON FROM INSURANCE A JOIN INSURANCE B ON A.TIV_2015 = B.TIV_2015 AND A.LAT!=B.LAT AND A.LON!=B.LON )A WHERE (A.LAT,A.LON) NOT IN (SELECT C.LAT,C.LON FROM INSURANCE C WHERE C.PID!=A.PID)
counterexample: INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (1, 1000, 1500, 34.0522, -118.2437); INSERT INTO INSURANCE (PID, TIV_2015, TIV_2016, LAT, LON) VALUES (2, 1000, 2000, 34.0523, -118.2438);
explanation: Q1 and Q2 are not equivalent. Q1 selects policies that have the same TIV_2015 as other policies and unique latitude and longitude. Q2 selects policies that have the same TIV_2015 as other policies and different latitude and longitude from all other policies.
counterexample_dsp: A policy with TIV_2015 = 1000, unique latitude and longitude, and another policy with the same TIV_2015 but different latitude and longitude.
